notes: searchRoots (line 266-269) checks both <serverDir>/worlds/ and <serverDir> itself, each subject to the same level.dat / skipDirs / seenNames rules, and unions the results — a world folder living directly in the server root and another living inside worlds/ are both discovered in one scan. Neither name matches the configured level-name ("world"), so the fallback alphabetical sort applies (line 348) and "creative" sorts before "survival".
